name: highlight-boost
description: Semantic highlighting for prose and code blocks in Obsidian.

scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.test:host: pnpm build && pnpm prepare:vault && node scripts/test-host.mjs
scripts.test:shiki: pnpm build && pnpm prepare:vault && node scripts/prepare-shiki.mjs && node scripts/test-host.mjs --shiki
scripts.test:shiki-live: pnpm build && pnpm prepare:vault && node scripts/test-shiki-live.mjs
scripts.test:embedded: pnpm build && pnpm prepare:vault && node scripts/test-host.mjs --mode=embedded
scripts.test:inline: pnpm build && pnpm prepare:vault && node scripts/test-host.mjs --mode=inline && node scripts/test-host.mjs --mode=inline-restart
scripts.test:prose: pnpm build && pnpm prepare:vault && node scripts/test-host.mjs --mode=prose && node scripts/test-host.mjs --mode=prose-restart
scripts.test:i18n: pnpm build && pnpm prepare:vault && node scripts/test-host.mjs --mode=i18n && node scripts/test-host.mjs --mode=i18n-restart
scripts.test:selection: pnpm build && pnpm prepare:vault && node scripts/test-host.mjs --mode=selection
scripts.test:phase-d: pnpm build && pnpm prepare:vault && node scripts/test-host.mjs --mode=phase-d && node scripts/test-host.mjs --mode=phase-d-restart
scripts.test:phase-e: pnpm build && pnpm prepare:vault && node scripts/test-host.mjs --mode=phase-e && node scripts/test-host.mjs --mode=phase-e-restart
scripts.test:notes: pnpm build && pnpm prepare:vault && node scripts/test-host.mjs --mode=notes && node scripts/test-host.mjs --mode=notes-restart
scripts.test:display: pnpm build && pnpm prepare:vault && node scripts/test-host.mjs --mode=display && node scripts/test-host.mjs --mode=display-restart
scripts.test:parameters: pnpm build && pnpm prepare:vault && node scripts/test-host.mjs --mode=parameters
scripts.test:migration: pnpm build && pnpm prepare:vault && node scripts/test-host.mjs --mode=migration && node scripts/test-host.mjs --mode=migration-restart
scripts.bench:host: pnpm build && pnpm prepare:vault && node scripts/test-host.mjs --mode=performance
scripts.bench:scale: pnpm build && node scripts/prepare-scale-vault.mjs && node scripts/test-host.mjs --mode=scale
scripts.test:pagination: pnpm build && pnpm prepare:vault && node scripts/test-host.mjs --mode=pagination
scripts.bench:responsive: pnpm build && node scripts/prepare-scale-vault.mjs --responsive && node scripts/test-host.mjs --mode=responsive
scripts.test:lifecycle: pnpm build && pnpm prepare:vault && node scripts/test-host.mjs --mode=lifecycle && node scripts/test-host.mjs --mode=lifecycle-shiki
scripts.test:multiwindow: pnpm build && node scripts/prepare-vault.mjs --suite=multiwindow && node scripts/test-host.mjs --mode=multiwindow
scripts.test:accessibility: pnpm build && node scripts/prepare-vault.mjs --suite=accessibility && node scripts/test-host.mjs --mode=accessibility
scripts.test:compatibility: pnpm build && node scripts/prepare-compatibility.mjs && node scripts/test-compatibility.mjs
scripts.test:frames: pnpm build && node scripts/prepare-vault.mjs --suite=frames && node scripts/test-host.mjs --mode=frames
